A firm dedicated to digital accessibility, for 15 years.

Our mission

To make accessibility a requirement you master, not a constraint you endure. We put our method at the service of organisations that want digital services everyone can use.

Our consultants work in France, Belgium, Luxembourg and Switzerland. They know the standards, laws and practices of each country, and work in French, Dutch, German and English.

Our expertise

01Digital accessibilityAudits, consulting and compliance work on your websites, apps and documents.02InclusionRecruiting people with disabilities and adapting internal tools.03TrainingLearning paths that make your teams self-sufficient, role by role.

Our commitments

  • Methodological rigourEvery criterion is checked manually and every result is documented.
  • A lead consultantOne point of contact, from scoping to final acceptance.
  • Actionable recommendationsConcrete, prioritised fixes that your teams can implement.
  • Real use at the centreOur audits are complemented by tests with people with disabilities.
